caption: The drawing features a single, symmetrical object centrally positioned on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object is rendered in gray graphite or pencil tones, giving it a metallic appearance, and appears to be a vessel or container, possibly a shaker. The base is circular and tiered, supporting a rounded, bulbous body with a subtle decorative band encircling its midsection. The upper section narrows and is topped with a domed lid perforated with evenly spaced, diagonal holes; the lid is capped with a small, detailed finial. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified line diagram of the same object, annotated with proportional measurements. The composition is minimal with significant empty space around the main object.
title: Silver Caster
